interpretation.null_policy: empty cell or declared NODATA value is missing; never zero-filled

preserved: every trace header and sample byte for byte (the exact original is the stored representation)
losses: Slices convert samples to float64 exactly; nothing is resampled
decisions: Textual header read as EBCDIC (cp037).
Binary header bytes 3217–3218: sample interval 4000, read as microseconds, so 4 ms.
Binary header bytes 3221–3222: 4 samples per trace; every trace agrees.
Binary header bytes 3225–3226: data format 1 (IBM 4-byte floating point), big-endian.
Trace header bytes 189–192: inline number.
Trace header bytes 193–196: crossline number.
Trace header bytes 181–184 and 185–188: CDP x and y, scaled by the coordinate scalar -100 (bytes 71–72).
6 traces form a full grid of 2 inlines × 3 crosslines; trace order in the file does not matter.
Trace header bytes 109–110: delay recording time 0, the same on every trace; sample k is at delay + k × interval (ms).
Coordinate scalar -100: coordinates divided by 100.
Slices address lines by their inline and crossline numbers as written in the trace headers, and samples by zero-based position.
IBM samples are converted to IEEE float64 exactly (no rounding).
